text: わたしの　つくった　カセキ　さいせい　マシンで　これ！

structure.jp: わたしの　つくった
カセキ　さいせい　マシンで

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わたしの　つくった　カセキ　さいせい　マシン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a thing tells you which thing. わたしの　つくった　カセキ　さいせい　マシン = 'the fossil-reviving machine that I made'.

patterns.name: 〜の (doer)
patterns.span: わたしの　つくった
patterns.explanation: Inside a phrase that describes a thing, の can stand in for が and show who does the action. わたしの　つくった = 'that I made'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a tool shows what you use to do something. マシンで = 'with the machine'.
